# glad-generated

GL 3.3 Core loader generated by the glad Python generator (v1 syntax).

Regenerate with:
  python3 -m glad --generator c --api "gl=3.3" --profile core \
    --out-path third_party/glad-generated --local-files

These committed sources let us build without a Python dependency. License:
glad is MIT (https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad).
